name: SOS Ras/Rac guanine nucleotide exchange factor 1

function.text: SOS1 encodes son of sevenless homolog 1. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activator activity and protein heterodimerization activity. It participates in signal transduction and Ras protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome 4 (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Endometrial Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
